```{r cars}
# Load required libraries
library(dplyr)

library(openxlsx)
df <- read.xlsx("BladderFYP_Ultrasound_Validation_processed.xlsx")
```



```{r, echo=FALSE}
BladderVolume <- function(depth, width, height) {
  # Calculate volume in mm^3
  volume_est <- depth * width * height * 0.72
  # Convert to ml (from mm^3)
  volume_est <- volume_est / 1000
  return(volume_est)
}
```


```{r}
Volumes <- vector("numeric", length = nrow(df))

for (i in 1:nrow(df)) {
  Volumes[i] <- BladderVolume(df$'D(scaled)'[i], df$'W(scaled)'[i], df$'H(scaled)'[i])
}
```

```{r}
# Add volumes to dataframe
df_volumed <- df %>% mutate(Volume_ml = Volumes)

# Different filtering versions (commented out for now)
# Keep all data (including missing/poor quality)
df_volumed_noNA <- df_volumed %>% filter(Label == 1 | Label == 2)

# Keep only good quality images
df_volumed_good <- df_volumed %>% filter(Label == 2)
```


```{r}
# For now, using the complete dataset
df_final <- df_volumed

# Create output filename
output_file <- gsub("\\.csv$", "_volumed.csv", "BladderFYP_Ultrasound_Validation_processed.csv")


# Write to CSV
write.csv(df_final, output_file, row.names = FALSE)

# Print confirmation
cat("Processing complete!\n")
#cat("Input file:", input_file, "\n")
cat("Output file:", output_file, "\n")
cat("Total rows processed:", nrow(df_final), "\n")
```
